newsitem.title: FRANCE: Two French fighters crash in Mediterranean.
newsitem.headline: Two French fighters crash in Mediterranean.

text.p: Two French Mirage-2000N fighters on a training flight crashed into the Mediterranean on Monday but all four crew escaped unhurt, the air force said.
An air force spokesman said details of the accident were still coming in and it was not yet clear where exactly it happened.
The four crew ejected to safety and were rescued by a ship. The aircraft were based in Istres, southern France. An investigation was under way to determine the cause of the crash.
